title: LDAP group members not showing in BAW task lists after AD restructure
description: Our IT team restructured Active Directory groups last week - merged three department groups into one. Since then, members of the new combined group cannot see tasks assigned to their team in Process Portal. The group name changed from 'HR-Dept' to 'HR-Operations'.

worklogs.description: Checked PAC User Management. The team binding still references 'HR-Dept' which no longer exists in LDAP.
Updated team binding in PAC to reference 'HR-Operations'. Triggered manual LDAP sync.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, I checked the BAW team configuration and found that the task routing team is still bound to the old 'HR-Dept' LDAP group which no longer exists after the AD restructure. I have updated the binding to 'HR-Operations' and triggered a manual LDAP sync. Could a few of the affected users log out and back in to test if they can now see their tasks?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Testing now with three users. Two of them can see the tasks but the third, Fatma Kaya, still cannot. She was in one of the old sub-groups that got merged.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The two users working confirms the main binding is correct. For Fatma, the issue might be a residual cache entry from her old group membership. Can you check whether she appears in the 'HR-Operations' group in Active Directory? If she does, I will flush the BAW LDAP cache for her specific user.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Checked AD - she is in HR-Operations. Must be a cache issue like you said.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Will restart the BAW user registry cache and force a full resync. Fatma's old group membership records from HR-Dept might still be cached in the WAS LDAP registry.
